summary: Keep governed test-stage inside owned project and ticket boundaries

delivery.outcome: Run governed tests only for owned bounded projects and preserve the accepted ticket scope: prune illustrative/foreign trees and keep slow-test observations advisory instead of mutating Planfile during governed publication. Reuse native ticket-181 and publish one atomic four-file material candidate through protected merge.
nonGoals: Change explicit project configuration or bootstrap commands
Change version, dependencies, delivery approval or production files outside the two owned paths

architecture.decision: Prune owned project discovery before selecting test commands, and preserve slow-test metrics while skipping implicit Planfile ticket creation in governed delivery modes. Existing ungoverned ticket-generation behavior remains tested. Restore the scoped discovery implementation from the preserved rejected candidate; discard only its known generated out-of-scope Planfile effect in the new unpublished branch. Original remote branch, local recovery ref, original intent, snapshots and test receipts remain recoverable.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected publication retaining independent receipts.

validation.evidence: Eight genuine discovery regressions plus governed test-stage mutation regressions preserve exact Planfile bytes and Git index while retaining performance metrics.
Full Python tests and native Goal publication succeed, with exact-head OneDev and independent protected merge.
